title: Analysis code for: Consensus independent component analysis resolves tumour spatial transcriptomics into interpretable transcriptional programmes
description:
R code reproducing the analyses of the manuscript Consensus independent component analysis resolves tumour spatial transcriptomics into interpretable transcriptional programmes.

consICA resolves a spatial expression matrix into transcriptional programmes without being given the coordinates of the spatial units. Each programme is a gene signature with a weight over every unit, and its spatial organization emerges in that map. The deposit covers the demonstration on five HEST-1k slides, four tumour types on two platforms, the comparison against single-run ICA configurations, and a cross-species section in which a human melanoma grows in mouse brain and every gene carries the genome it mapped to.

The expression matrices are not redistributed. scripts/download_hest.R fetches them from HEST-1k, and README.md gives the requirements and the order in which the scripts run.
notes: The code is released under the MIT licence. One file, scripts/benchmark/cfs_ICASpatial.R, is copied from CellsFromSpace and carries that package's GPL, whose text is in LICENSE.GPL-2. The spatial transcriptomics data the scripts read are third-party, carry their own terms and are not redistributed here.
